beats.care: Ride a two-wheeler in PCMC at rush hour? Stay alert near big junctions, since many trucks ignore the timings.
beats.what: From January to September, police booked 90,606 heavy vehicles and collected over ₹11.9 crore in fines.
beats.why: Goods traffic from Bhosari, Chakan and Talegaon crowds the roads. The time curbs aim to keep peak traffic moving.

cards.body: DCP (traffic) Vikrant Deshmukh said strict action is being taken against violators.
cards.caption: fines collected in nine months

cards.body: Goods move from industrial areas like Bhosari, Talegaon, Chakan and Ranjangaon toward Mumbai, Pune and beyond, often through Pimpri Chinchwad.

opts: Keep heavy vehicles off key routes at rush hours
cards.q: What are the timing curbs meant to do?
cards.why: The curbs cover morning and evening peaks so commuter traffic flows better.

cards.q: Trucks at rush hour: your take?

hook: How many trucks *broke PCMC's rush-hour ban* this year?

learn.t: Heavy vehicles are barred on set Pimpri Chinchwad routes from 8 am to noon and from 4 pm to 9 pm.

sources.name: Punekar News
sources.title: Pune: Heavy Vehicles Flout PCMC Entry Curbs; Over 90,000 Booked in 9 Months, Rs 11.9 Crore in Fines Collected

tldr: Pimpri Chinchwad traffic police booked 90,606 heavy vehicles for breaking rush-hour entry curbs from January to September.
